one_liner: Sales CRM with a broad REST API (v1/v2) using an API token or OAuth 2.0; free self-serve developer sandbox; official hosted Pipedrive MCP server.
notes: auth: personal API token (x-api-token header) for single-account integrations, and OAuth 2.0 for apps. access: no free Pipedrive plan, but the Developers' Corner offers a self-serve developer sandbox (email + first-name sign-up form; 'like a regular Pipedrive company account', 5 seats). That is a free developer account -> self_serve_free; a 14-day product trial also exists. Marketplace listing of a public app needs Pipedrive review, but private apps and API tokens do not, so it is not gating. Sandbox accounts are deleted if there is no app activity within about 6 months (minor). api_style: REST only (no public GraphQL). mcp: Pipedrive's own hosted MCP server (OAuth; listed in Claude/ChatGPT connector directories), described on pipedrive.com as built and maintained by Pipedrive and available on all plans.
